title: A shared journal for loved ones
description: The chosen question and the answers are available whenever it suits, without opening the personal archive.

blocks.text: Ordinary messaging does not always give a reason to talk about yourself at length, especially at a distance.

quote.text: Really good for getting to know your family and friends better plus you get fun and exiting questions!

blocks.text: Let the topic and the rhythm be chosen, keep the history of the exchange and clear visibility rules. Keep private entries separate from shared ones.
A missing answer should not be turned into a verdict on the relationship or a contest between the participants.
